the DSC operator provides a general and flexible tool to design robust PLL for different types of grid voltage distortion, which is of great importance in grid synchronization of distributed generation units.
the DSC operator can effectively remove harmonics in voltage signal and the proposed PLL designs can achieve fast transient response without sacrificing steady-state accuracy.
